segments.title: essence and mistaken perception
segments.note: Provisional machine alignment by Codex (Tibetan-first independent proposal); no human semantic approval. gnas lugs is attested in the original HGM glossary as independent reality; ngo bo nyid as very essence. ldog is locally the cessation/disappearance predicate and mi its negation. Omit gsal du 'gro dgos kyi and the English although they should have: the Tibetan expects becoming clear, whereas the English ellipsis appears to repeat disappear. Omission marks unresolved or contradictory correspondence, not an asserted null. Omit the restructured de'i tshe and zhes pa'i frame; don retains meaning. English exist is the whole word after would, not a substring of existed. All source text remains verbatim.
